body:
Please report these advisories to the affected projects and update the packages in the audited environment. The output identifies Pygments and Requests; Pygments is a Rich dependency, while Requests is not listed as one, so this output does not by itself show that Rich is vulnerable. If you have evidence of a vulnerability in Rich itself, report it through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
